background: State Street Corporation is the holding company of one of the world's largest custodian banks, earning fees from safekeeping, fund administration and asset management under the State Street Global Advisors brand.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the group, A+ on average and the weakest at A, both on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch downgrade on 2 Dec 2015. Capital is split against US banks: CET1 of 10.8% is in the bottom quarter, which is the figure to watch, while leverage of 6.2% is in the top quarter. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Sep 2026.
